title: Find the Buying Committee at a Target Account
summary: How go-to-market teams and their coding agents list every stakeholder at a target account by seniority and department with Cargo: one AI Ark people search per account domain, 0.05 credits per person, and a batch for a whole account list.
body_markdown:
**To find the buying committee at a target account, run Cargo’s` aiArk.searchPeople` action with the account’s domain plus the seniorities and departments that buy from you. It returns every matching person with name, title, LinkedIn URL and company domain at 0.05 credits each, so a 20-person committee costs 1 credit and an account with no match costs nothing.**


For a whole go-to-market account list, run the same search as one batch, one record per domain. These are the steps behind the[find-stakeholders](https://www.getcargo.ai/skills/find-stakeholders) skill.


## What it costs#


From the action’s credit definition: 0.05 credits per person returned, and 0 for a search that returns no one. One call fetches up to 100 people and one run up to 2,000, so a committee search never needs paging by hand. A new account starts with 100 free credits and no card: 2,000 stakeholders.


No AI Ark account is needed. Unless you connect your own AI Ark key, Cargo runs the search on its key and bills credits.


## Run it#


### 1. Install and sign in


shellscript


```text
npm   install   -g   @cargo-ai/cli
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com                   # sends a code
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com   --code   123456     # creates the account on first use


```


### 2. One account


Directors, VPs and the C-suite in sales, marketing, operations and finance at acme.com:


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"aiArk","actionSlug":"searchPeople"}'   \
--data   '{
"companyInfo": {"domain_or": ["acme.com"]},
"jobRole": {
"seniority_or": ["c_suite", "vp", "head", "director"],
"department_or": ["sales", "marketing", "operations", "finance"]
},
"limit": 25
}'   \
--wait-until-finished


```


Seniority and department values come from AI Ark’s fixed lists, in lowercase:


Filter Values


` jobRole.seniority_or`` founder` ,` owner` ,` partner` ,` c_suite` ,` vp` ,` director` ,` head` ,` manager` ,` senior` ,` mid-level` ,` entry` ,` intern`


` jobRole.department_or`` sales` ,` sales_operations` ,` marketing` ,` finance` ,` operations` ,` software_development` ,` data_science` , and more


A value outside the list (` CXO` ,` VP` ,` Sales` ) fails validation, so copy them exactly. Each filter has a` _not` twin (` seniority_not` ,` department_not` ) to remove, for example, interns or a department that never signs.


To name the roles instead of the departments, use` jobRole.title_or` (current title matches any of these) and` jobRole.title_not` . To find people who held a role before,` jobRole.previous_title_or` .


### 3. A list of accounts


One record per account.` --limit 5` runs a pilot on the first five so you can check the committees before the full spend:


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute-batch   \
--records   '[
{"companyInfo": {"domain_or": ["acme.com"]}, "jobRole": {"seniority_or": ["c_suite", "vp", "director"], "department_or": ["sales", "finance"]}, "limit": 25},
{"companyInfo": {"domain_or": ["globex.com"]}, "jobRole": {"seniority_or": ["c_suite", "vp", "director"], "department_or": ["sales", "finance"]}, "limit": 25}
]'   \
--limit   5   --wait-until-finished


```


Download the results with` cargo-ai orchestration batch download --uuid <batch uuid>` . Keep` limit` per account low (25 is a generous committee): the cost is per person returned, and the bill for a large account list scales with it.


## What comes back#


Each person carries AI Ark’s full record plus flat fields:` full_name` ,` first_name` ,` last_name` ,` title` ,` headline` ,` linkedin_url` ,` company_name` ,` company_domain` ,` country` ,` state` ,` city` .


Before anyone acts on the list:


- **Check` company_domain` against the account.** It is the fastest way to catch a person attached to a subsidiary or a similarly named company.
- **Drop the contacts you already own.** Match` linkedin_url` against your CRM before enriching: re-enriching a known contact is paid twice.
- **Find their emails as a second step.** The search returns profiles, not contact details. Send names and the domain to the[work email waterfall](https://www.getcargo.ai/blog/find-and-verify-work-emails-at-scale) .


Which roles belong on the committee is a sales decision, not a data one;[buying committee mapping](https://www.getcargo.ai/blog/buying-committee-mapping-and-engagement) covers how to choose them. To source people across many companies by title rather than inside one account, see[find B2B leads by job title, company and keyword](https://www.getcargo.ai/blog/find-b2b-leads-by-job-title-company-and-keyword) .


## Frequently asked questions#


Run` aiArk.searchPeople` with the company’s domain in` companyInfo.domain_or` and the seniorities and departments you sell to in` jobRole` . It returns every match, up to the` limit` you set.


0.05 credits per person returned, nothing when no one matches. A 20-person committee is 1 credit.


Yes. Pass one record per account to` execute-batch` , pilot it on five with` --limit 5` , then run the rest.


No. It returns names, titles and LinkedIn URLs. Find emails and phones in a separate step, only for the people you will contact.
